verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification platform, so document-free database verification is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack only documents document-, NFC- and biometric-based session flows plus PEP/sanctions watchlist screening. Watchlist screening is an adjacent check, not verification of identity against SSN, national-registry or credit-header sources, so nothing in the pack shows a documentless data-check capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify identity against authoritative databases without documents — SSN, national registries, or credit-header data — for lower-friction flows where a doc scan is overkill
